title: Executable Rule-Set Authority Resolution
closure_line: JOURNAL 1 LAYER 3 PROTOTYPE BATCH 4A CLOSED — EXECUTABLE RULE-SET AUTHORITY AND LAYER-BOUNDARY INTERFACE RESOLVED
decision_basis: Model B preserves the Layer 2/3 architectural boundary: Layer 2 computes g_i(.) once; Layer 3 consumes results only.
Safety Dominance (Theorem C.3, Appendix C §C.7.2) depends only on the value of S, not on additional interface content. Model B does not affect the proof.
layer3-prototype-specification.md §7 explicitly permits implementation-level additions to DecisionContext in later batches.
Component state domain at Layer 3 interface is {SAFE, CAUTION, EXCLUDED} — UNSAFE is unreachable (gate-off), FAULTED is absorbed by UNSAFE gate-off.
Model A (raw-value expansion) rejected: duplicates Layer 2 classifier thresholds in Layer 3.
Model C (reasons taxonomy) rejected: architecturally prohibited by Appendix C §C.2.0.8 and §C.7.2.
Model D (full deferral) partially accepted for R-SAFE-001 (STATE_RESTATEMENT); Model B preferred for R-CAUTION-002/003/004.

R-SAFE-001.reason: Antecedent all(g_i==SAFE) is logically equivalent to S=SAFE under max-severity. When Layer 3 executes with state=SAFE, all component states are already SAFE — rule fires unconditionally, creating automatic SAFE->Go mapping. No additional environmental discriminant. Requires bounded scientific decision before implementation.

R-CAUTION-001.reason: Already implemented in Batch 3. resolved_m=='advisory' is directly executable. Future migration to m_state=='CAUTION' (Model B consistency) is a consideration for Batch 4B — not actioned in Batch 4A.

R-CAUTION-002.reason: g_o(o,v)==CAUTION is an already-computed Layer 2 result. Layer 3 may consume it as component_o_state without duplicating g_o thresholds or vessel-category logic.
R-CAUTION-002.implementation_authorised_note: Authorised in principle; requires Batch 4B canonical update (architecture-illustration.md) plus interface specification and review.

R-CAUTION-003.reason: g_r(r,kappa)==CAUTION is an already-computed Layer 2 result. Two-input rainfall semantics (rate+kappa) remain inside Layer 2. Layer 3 consumes r_state only.
R-CAUTION-003.implementation_authorised_note: Authorised in principle; requires Batch 4B canonical update (architecture-illustration.md) plus interface specification and review.

R-CAUTION-004.reason: g_w(w)==CAUTION is an already-computed Layer 2 result. Thresholds 21.6/27.0 kn remain inside Layer 2. Layer 3 consumes w_state only.
R-CAUTION-004.implementation_authorised_note: Authorised in principle; requires Batch 4B canonical update (architecture-illustration.md) plus interface specification and review.

R_SAFE_001_state_restatement_result.proof_summary: f(E) = max-severity(...); S=SAFE iff all non-excluded g_i=SAFE. Under Layer 3 execution context (state=SAFE), all component states are already SAFE by the gate-off invariant. R-SAFE-001 antecedent is unconditionally TRUE in every S=SAFE episode. Rule adds no environmental discriminant beyond S=SAFE itself.
R_SAFE_001_state_restatement_result.action: DEFERRED — requires bounded scientific decision: (a) add additional discriminant to antecedent, or (b) explicitly document SAFE->Go as an accepted architectural design choice with scientific justification.
